column1: # Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist : Link Evolution on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Konami's engine on SDK 5.6, update 1.0.1 (v65536); OpenGL ES 3.2 through the device's EGL/GLES driver (gl_android.c), GLSL compiled at run time, no shader bundle.
# Experimental: tested on the AYN Odin 2 (Adreno 740) through the title, a story duel, cutscenes, the card shop and saving. 30 fps by default (game.tsv fps_ceiling).
# Bring-up log: the movie shaders' stray ';' after `void main() {...};` is a syntax error on Adreno (NVIDIA accepts it): DM_GL_STRAY_SEMI=1 (gl_android.c) removes it.
